title: Wow
text: What an unbelievable experience! The musicians, singers and dancers were all phenomenal! I thoroughly enjoyed my first experience of flamenco and can happily say I wasn’t disappointed! The acoustics in the studio were amazing and really added to the experience! The guitar museum is fascinating and getting to listen to the differences between classical and flamenco guitars was astounding! I would 1 million percent recommend this experience to all! Olé ❤️
